WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ $json.dry_run ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS dry_run,
    '{{ $json.force ? "true" : "false" }}'::boolean AS force_dispatch,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF('{{ $json.limit || "" }}', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
        THEN LEAST(GREATEST(NULLIF('{{ $json.limit || "" }}', '')::integer, 1), 500)
      ELSE LEAST(GREATEST(get_system_config_int('campaign.outbound.dispatch-batch-size', 50), 1), 500)
    END AS batch_limit,
    NULLIF('{{ $json.brand || "" }}', '') AS brand,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $json.source || "" }}', ''), 'schedule') AS source
), gate AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    get_system_config_bool('campaign.outbound.dispatch-enabled', false) AS dispatch_enabled
  FROM params p
), pending AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS lead_id,
    l.quicklink_id,
    l.marca::text AS marca,
    l.nombre_cliente,
    l.telefono_1,
    l.telefono_agente,
    l.modelo,
    l.sincronizado_at,
    l.created_at
  FROM leads_quicklink l
  CROSS JOIN gate g
  WHERE (g.dry_run OR g.force_dispatch OR g.dispatch_enabled)
    AND l.estado_agente = 'PENDIENTE'
    AND l.conversacion_id IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(l.telefono_agente, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND length(regexp_replace(l.telefono_agente, '\D', '', 'g')) BETWEEN 9 AND 15
    AND (g.brand IS NULL OR l.marca::text = g.brand)
  ORDER BY l.sincronizado_at ASC, l.created_at ASC
  LIMIT (SELECT batch_limit FROM gate)
)
SELECT
  g.dry_run,
  g.force_dispatch,
  g.dispatch_enabled,
  g.batch_limit,
  g.brand,
  g.source,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.sincronizado_at ASC, p.created_at ASC) FILTER (WHERE p.lead_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS leads,
  COUNT(p.lead_id)::integer AS lead_count
FROM gate g
LEFT JOIN pending p ON true
GROUP BY g.dry_run, g.force_dispatch, g.dispatch_enabled, g.batch_limit, g.brand, g.source;
